title: SQL Injection to File System Read

technique.summary: Chain SQL injection with database file-read functions to read arbitrary files from the server filesystem, including application source code, configuration files with credentials, and /etc/passwd.
steps: Confirm SQL injection exists (boolean-based, union-based, or error-based)
Determine the database type (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL)
Identify the number of columns in the original query (for UNION-based)
MySQL: Use LOAD_FILE('/etc/passwd') in a UNION SELECT
PostgreSQL: Use pg_read_file('/etc/passwd') or COPY ... FROM
Escalate: Read application config files for database credentials, API keys

payloads.notes: MySQL file read via UNION injection
MySQL — hex-encoded path to bypass WAF
PostgreSQL COPY TO PROGRAM — can lead to RCE

bypassTechniques: Hex-encode file paths to bypass WAF keyword filtering
Use CHAR() function to construct strings without quotes
Use INTO OUTFILE to write webshell if write permissions exist
